Measurement weirdo

library(tidyverse)
triggerR <- new.env()
source("R/read_data.R", local = triggerR)
if (!exists("trigger_5min")) trigger_5min <- triggerR$read_trigger_5min()

PM / PC extreme values

pm <- trigger_5min %>%
  filter(origin == "myair", str_starts(variable, "pm|pc")) %>%
  select(userId, bucket_5min, variable, mean)
pm %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(mean)),
    missing = sum(is.na(mean)),
    q25 = quantile(mean, .25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50 = quantile(mean, .50, na.rm = TRUE),
    q95 = quantile(mean, .95, na.rm = TRUE),
    q99 = quantile(mean, .99, na.rm = TRUE),
    q999 = quantile(mean, .999, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

pm_wide <- pm %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "variable", values_from = "mean")

cor_panel <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  x <- rlang::eval_tidy(mapping$x, data)
  y <- rlang::eval_tidy(mapping$y, data)
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)

  r <- rho <- NA_real_
  if (sum(ok) > 2 && sd(x[ok]) > 0 && sd(y[ok]) > 0) {
    r <- cor(x[ok], y[ok], method = "pearson")
    rho <- cor(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman")
  }

  ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text", x = 0, y = 0, size = 4,
      label = sprintf("Pearson: %.2f\nSpearman: %.2f", r, rho)
    ) +
    theme_void()
}

point_panel <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  data %>%
    slice_sample(n = min(10000, nrow(data))) %>%
    ggplot(mapping) +
    geom_point(alpha = .1, size = .3)
}

set.seed(123)

p_pair <- GGally::ggpairs(
  pm_wide %>% select(starts_with(c("pm", "pc"))),
  upper = list(continuous = cor_panel),
  lower = list(continuous = point_panel)
)
p_pair

pm <- c("pm1", "pm25", "pm10")
pc <- c("pc03", "pc05", "pc1", "pc25", "pc5", "pc10")

air <- trigger_5min %>%
  filter(origin == "myair", variable %in% c(pm, pc)) %>%
  select(userId, bucket_5min, variable, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = mean) %>%
  mutate(
    bad_pm = pm1 > pm25 | pm25 > pm10 | pm1 > pm10,
    bad_pc = pc03 < pc05 | pc05 < pc1 | pc1 < pc25 | pc25 < pc5 | pc5 < pc10,
    extreme = if_any(all_of(c(pm, pc)), ~ .x >= 60000),
    suspect = coalesce(bad_pm, FALSE) |
      coalesce(bad_pc, FALSE) | coalesce(extreme, FALSE))
episodes <- air %>%
  filter(suspect) %>%
  group_by(userId) %>%
  arrange(bucket_5min, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    gap = as.numeric(difftime(bucket_5min, lag(bucket_5min), units = "mins")),
    episode = cumsum(is.na(gap) | gap != 5)
  ) %>%
  group_by(userId, episode) %>%
  summarise(
    start = min(bucket_5min),
    end = max(bucket_5min),
    buckets = n(),
    extreme = sum(extreme, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(extreme), desc(buckets)) %>%
  mutate(id = row_number(), .before = 1)

episodes %>% select(-userId, -episode)

# ℹ 276 more rows
event <- episodes %>% filter(id == 2)

view <- air %>%
  semi_join(event, by = "userId") %>%
  filter(
    bucket_5min >= event$start - lubridate::hours(1),
    bucket_5min <= event$end + lubridate::hours(1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(bucket_5min) %>%
  mutate(
    segment = cumsum(c(TRUE, diff(as.numeric(bucket_5min)) != 300))
  ) %>%
  select(bucket_5min, segment, suspect, all_of(c(pm, pc))) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(c(pm, pc)), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = c(pm, pc)))

p_event <- ggplot(view, aes(bucket_5min, value)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = segment), linewidth = .3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = suspect), size = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey50", "TRUE" = "#D73027")) +
  labs(x = "Time (UTC)", y = "Five-minute mean", colour = "Flagged row") +
  theme_minimal()
p_event
